title: Ezekiel 42: The Priests' Chambers and the Separation of the Sanctuary
body:
Read the chapter → [Ezekiel 42](/bible/ezekiel/42)

**[Ezekiel 42:1-9](/bible/ezekiel/42#v1)**

> <sup>[1](/bible/ezekiel/42#v1)</sup> Then he brought me forth into the utter court, the way toward the north: and he brought me into the chamber that was over against the separate place, and which was before the building toward the north.
>
> <sup>[2](/bible/ezekiel/42#v2)</sup> Before the length of an hundred cubits was the north door, and the breadth was fifty cubits.
>
> <sup>[3](/bible/ezekiel/42#v3)</sup> Over against the twenty cubits which were for the inner court, and over against the pavement which was for the utter court, was gallery against gallery in three stories.
>
> <sup>[4](/bible/ezekiel/42#v4)</sup> And before the chambers was a walk of ten cubits breadth inward, a way of one cubit; and their doors toward the north.
>
> <sup>[5](/bible/ezekiel/42#v5)</sup> Now the upper chambers were shorter: for the galleries were higher than these, than the lower, and than the middlemost of the building.
>
> <sup>[6](/bible/ezekiel/42#v6)</sup> For they were in three stories, but had not pillars as the pillars of the courts: therefore the building was straitened more than the lowest and the middlemost from the ground.
>
> <sup>[7](/bible/ezekiel/42#v7)</sup> And the wall that was without over against the chambers, toward the utter court on the forepart of the chambers, the length thereof was fifty cubits.
>
> <sup>[8](/bible/ezekiel/42#v8)</sup> For the length of the chambers that were in the utter court was fifty cubits: and, lo, before the temple were an hundred cubits.
>
> <sup>[9](/bible/ezekiel/42#v9)</sup> And from under these chambers was the entry on the east side, as one goeth into them from the utter court.

- Ezekiel is brought into the outer court toward the north, into the chamber over against the separate place, a hundred cubits long and fifty broad, about a hundred feet by seventy feet. Gallery is against gallery in three stories.
- Before the chambers is a walk of ten cubits breadth inward, a way of one cubit, with doors toward the north, about fifteen feet and a foot and a half. The upper chambers are shorter because the galleries take away more from them, and the building has no pillars like the courts. An entry on the east side leads into them from the outer court.

**[Ezekiel 42:10-14](/bible/ezekiel/42#v10)**

> <sup>[10](/bible/ezekiel/42#v10)</sup> The chambers were in the thickness of the wall of the court toward the east, over against the separate place, and over against the building.
>
> <sup>[11](/bible/ezekiel/42#v11)</sup> And the way before them was like the appearance of the chambers which were toward the north, as long as they, and as broad as they: and all their goings out were both according to their fashions, and according to their doors.
>
> <sup>[12](/bible/ezekiel/42#v12)</sup> And according to the doors of the chambers that were toward the south was a door in the head of the way, even the way directly before the wall toward the east, as one entereth into them.
>
> <sup>[13](/bible/ezekiel/42#v13)</sup> Then said he unto me, The north chambers and the south chambers, which are before the separate place, they be holy chambers, where the priests that approach unto the Lord shall eat the most holy things: there shall they lay the most holy things, and the meat offering, and the sin offering, and the trespass offering; for the place is holy.
>
> <sup>[14](/bible/ezekiel/42#v14)</sup> When the priests enter therein, then shall they not go out of the holy place into the utter court, but there they shall lay their garments wherein they minister; for they are holy; and shall put on other garments, and shall approach to those things which are for the people.

- The angel tells Ezekiel the north chambers and the south chambers before the separate place are holy chambers where the priests who approach the Lord shall eat the most holy things and lay the meat offering, the sin offering, and the trespass offering, because the place is holy.
- When the priests enter, they shall not go out into the outer court until they lay aside the garments in which they minister, for those garments are holy. They put on other garments before they approach the things that are for the people. These are the laws the Levite priests are to follow.

**[Ezekiel 42:15-20](/bible/ezekiel/42#v15)**

> <sup>[15](/bible/ezekiel/42#v15)</sup> Now when he had made an end of measuring the inner house, he brought me forth toward the gate whose prospect is toward the east, and measured it round about.
>
> <sup>[16](/bible/ezekiel/42#v16)</sup> He measured the east side with the measuring reed, five hundred reeds, with the measuring reed round about.
>
> <sup>[17](/bible/ezekiel/42#v17)</sup> He measured the north side, five hundred reeds, with the measuring reed round about.
>
> <sup>[18](/bible/ezekiel/42#v18)</sup> He measured the south side, five hundred reeds, with the measuring reed.
>
> <sup>[19](/bible/ezekiel/42#v19)</sup> He turned about to the west side, and measured five hundred reeds with the measuring reed.
>
> <sup>[20](/bible/ezekiel/42#v20)</sup> He measured it by the four sides: it had a wall round about, five hundred reeds long, and five hundred broad, to make a separation between the sanctuary and the profane place.

- When the angel finishes measuring the inner house, he brings Ezekiel out by the east gate and measures the whole compass round about, five hundred reeds on the east side, five hundred on the north, five hundred on the south, and five hundred on the west, about fifty-five hundred feet per side.
- It has a wall round about, five hundred reeds long and five hundred broad, to make a separation between the sanctuary and the profane place. By rehearsing these measurements in such detail, the vision is pointing to the kingdom: the temple will be established again with the same measurements given to King Solomon, done all over again. As for why the Father requires such careful preparation, that is above our pay grade; we are to follow and learn, for His thoughts are not our thoughts.
  - **[Isaiah 55:8](/bible/isaiah/55#v8)**
    > <sup>[8](/bible/isaiah/55#v8)</sup> For my thoughts are not your thoughts, neither are your ways my ways, saith the Lord.

    The Most High's thoughts and ways are higher than ours, so the reason for such exact preparation belongs to Him.
  - **[Isaiah 60:10](/bible/isaiah/60#v10)**
    > <sup>[10](/bible/isaiah/60#v10)</sup> And the sons of strangers shall build up thy walls, and their kings shall minister unto thee: for in my wrath I smote thee, but in my favour have I had mercy on thee.

    The sons of strangers will build up the walls and their kings will minister, so the other nations build the temple while Israel's working days are over.
